transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to discuss the scheduled gearbox maintenance for Automated Palletizer P-7 this weekend. Before I finalize the maintenance window and operating plan, I'd like to hear from maintenance, logistics, and safety on any constraints or concerns we should account for. As you know, P-7 normally transfers completed pallets to Dock 3, and finished-goods space for manually staged pallets is limited — so we'll need to plan carefully around that.

transcript.text: Elena, I need to share an important finding from my vibration assessment. I found a cracked gearbox bearing in P-7 that could seize under load. I'm recommending we start the replacement Saturday at 06:00. The work will require exactly 6 hours to complete, and P-7 must not operate at all during the repair. I completed this assessment yesterday, but I want to flag that I haven't yet attached it to the maintenance work order — I'll make sure to do that.
